title: micro-quant-playbook-weekly-capture-dec06-2027
summary: Weekly capture for micro-quant playbook sprint: focus on low-latency INT8 variants, KV-prefetch heuristics for interactive loads, and building a minimal onboarding checklist for new model families.
notes:
Meeting: Applied ML weekly research sync — Dec 06 2027
Attendees: Anika, Marco, Sara, Evan, Riley (and recorded async comments in Slack)
Context: This sprint we split work into three lanes: (1) lightweight INT8 probes for LLaMA-family derivatives, (2) KV-cache prefetch policy experiments for chat-like traffic, (3) onboarding checklist + eval harness for 7B-13B open checkpoint candidates.

1) INT8 probe updates
- Experiment snapshot: ran q4_0 / perchannel-int8 / static calibration on two checkpoints derived from llama-7b-v2. Each run used a 512-token context and batching simulating 50 RPS with 8-token median responses.
- Preliminary numbers (median latency p50 on A100, single-replica, cold-start): float32 baseline 18ms/token, q4_0 7.2ms/token (x2.5 speedup), observed median perplexity delta ~+0.6pp on our targeted chat eval set (prompt-set: onboarding-chat-v3).
- Stability: q4_0 has occasional token-level off-by-one in code-gen style prompts. Fail case trace linked in PR comments. Need deterministic seed reruns and longer chains to measure drift.
- Action agreed: add a small targeted eval suite (10 prompts) that emphasize whitespace-sensitive output (code and json). Mark as gating for any INT8 variant used in hosted API.

2) KV-cache prefetch heuristics
- Motivation: interactive traffic shows many short-turn chats where prefix reuse is high but tail latency spikes due to cache miss/rehydration.
- Experiment design: simulate 3-day traffic trace slice for a mid-market customer (synthetic anonymized) and test two strategies: (A) eager-prefetch-first-n (n=64 tokens), (B) demand-based microprefetch (heuristic: prefetch next chunk if current generation > 8 tokens).
- Outcome: (A) reduces p99 latency by ~9% at cost of 12% extra GPU memory churn; (B) reduces p99 by ~5% with negligible extra memory but slightly higher p50.
- Decision: ship B as default microprefetch for Dedicated with opt-in flag for eager-prefetch on high-latency-sensitive customers. Add telemetry counters for prefetch hits and memory churn.

3) Model onboarding checklist (first draft)
- Purpose: a minimal set of checks and artifacts required before a model is marked 'onboarding-ready' in the catalog. This is intentionally lightweight to speed pace. Proposed items:
  * checkpoint provenance + license string
  * sample generation sweep (50 prompts across categories) with baseline quality thresholds
  * quantized probe results (INT8/FP16 numbers) and regressions noted
  * perf profile (p50/p90/p99 at 1x, 5x, 20x traffic) on standard infra
  * tokenization parity tests (esp. custom unicode cases)
  * safety/TOX quick-check using our eval harness (existing classifiers)
  * model card stub and recommended default route config (batching, kv-cache settings)
- Responsibility: Sara will draft the checklist template. Marco will run it on the two candidate checkpoints by EOD next Wednesday.

4) Eval harness improvements
- Need tighter diffs: current eval outputs are too noisy for small quantization regressions. Proposed changes: add per-example deterministic seed, record token-level edit distance, and enable side-by-side diff for human review.
- Quick win: Evan will add token-diff output to the existing runner and a simple HTML viewer for triage.

5) Open risks and questions
- Accuracy sensitivity: for some code prompts, INT8 seems to produce logically valid but subtly incorrect tokens — we need to decide tolerance thresholds for production usage. Risk: rolling out too early will increase customer escape rates.
- Tooling gaps: no easy way to mark a specific prompt-set as "sensitive" for gating. We should allow metadata tags on prompt-sets (Sara to file Linear ticket ML-520).
- Resource modeling: micro-prefetch increases short-term memory churn; need SRE input on eviction policies and observability before enabling by default.

6) Operational notes
- Telemetry to add this sprint: "quant-variant" tag in perf traces, prefetch.hit/miss counters, per-prompt token-diff histogram. Add these as columns in the console cost/latency dashboard (product).
- Canary plan: for any INT8 rollout, do canary on Dedicated pool with 2% traffic, monitor quality regressions for 48h, automatic rollback on >1.5% of sessions with token-diff > threshold.

7) Misc rapid items
- PR #1425 contains the micro-prefetch prototype; tagging for review.
- Marco noted a flaky test in the qbench harness — test_qbench_stream_rehydrate; skipping until fix.
- Riley will prepare a short deck for next week's PG meeting outlining the playbook and the gating criteria.

Meeting adjourned; next sync: Dec 13 2027 (same time).
